entity.name: Construction Pro Manager
entity.description:
Andrew Arena created a project management software that truly serves the needs of project managers, construction companies, clients, subcontractors and all other project participants. 

Construction Pro Manager requires very little training, is intuitive and logical to a project manager and has a clearly organized system for document storage and retrieval. Best of all, it was designed to be affordable for small to mid-size construction firms. 

The central element of Construction Pro Manager is its patent-pending CLS-Contractor Linked System. It starts with three primary filing categories that are familiar to all project managers: Administrative, Technical and Field. Within each of these are a total of 42 construction-based logs and 23 essential forms, breakdowns and scheduling modules, which is an organizational structure that project managers and contractors already know intuitively, so they don’t need to learn an entirely new system or way of thinking.

The CLS-Contractor Linked System makes it easy to file and quickly retrieve such documents as project schedule, insurance, purchase order, requisition, request for proposal, email, operational & maintenance manual, contract drawings, equipment training, punch list, scope of work, accident report, daily time sheet, safety violation, inspection report and many others.

Construction Pro Manager is a password-protected, cloud-based application that can be used from desktop and laptop computers as well as with its view-only mobile application for smartphones and tablets.

It is subscription-based software that costs only $125–$175 per month, with annual, biannual and recurring monthly subscription options. Each subscription includes unlimited users per each contractor client, unlimited projects per each contractor client and daily technical support.

Construction Pro Manager was launched during 2014, and complete information about the product can be found at www.constructionpromanager.com.
